title: Navigate between portfolio sections from the main page
description: A visitor can use the page navigation to reach the key portfolio sections and continue browsing the single-page layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link for the about section
Verify the about section is displayed
Click the navigation link for the projects section
Verify the projects section is displayed

title: Browse the portfolio by scrolling through sections
description: A visitor can scroll through the homepage and see the main sections appear in sequence as they move down the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page
Verify the about or skills content is displayed
Scroll further down the page
Verify the projects and contact sections are displayed

title: Submit the contact form successfully
description: A visitor can send a message with valid contact details and see a success notification after submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with Ada Lovelace
Fill in the email field with ada@example.com
Fill in the message field with a brief inquiry about the portfolio
Submit the contact form
Verify a success notification is visible

title: Open a featured project link and continue browsing
description: A visitor can review a featured project, open its external link, and return to the portfolio to keep exploring.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the projects section
Click an external link from a featured project
Verify the project destination opens in a new page or tab context
Return to the portfolio page
Verify the portfolio projects section is still accessible

title: Use the mobile menu to jump to a section
description: A mobile visitor can open the navigation menu and reach a selected portfolio section from the single-page layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a mobile size
Open the mobile navigation menu
Click the mobile menu link for the projects section
Verify the projects section is displayed

title: Show validation when the contact form is submitted empty
description: A visitor who submits the contact form without required details sees validation feedback instead of a successful submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Submit the contact form
Verify validation feedback is visible

title: Show validation when the contact form email is incomplete
description: A visitor entering an invalid email address in the contact form receives validation feedback and cannot submit successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with Ada Lovelace
Fill in the email field with an invalid email address
Fill in the message field with a brief inquiry about the portfolio
Submit the contact form
Verify email validation feedback is visible

title: Show validation when the contact form message is missing
description: A visitor leaving the message field empty sees validation feedback and the form is not accepted.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with Ada Lovelace
Fill in the email field with ada@example.com
Submit the contact form
Verify message validation feedback is visible
